title: Moose (Pre-Initialized)
tagline: Same as OLAP for SWE, but the project is already scaffolded.
description: Identical tooling to `olap-for-swe` (MooseStack + ClickHouse), except a Moose project is pre-scaffolded at `/workspace/moose-project` before the agent starts. Isolates the cost of `moose init` from the rest of the agent's work so we can measure whether that first step is a bottleneck.
postInstallScript: mkdir -p /opt/dec-bench/moose && cd /opt/dec-bench/moose && npm init -y && npm install @514labs/moose-lib@0.6.518
